description: Two people on one Supabase project, side by side, each in their own SvGrid Base on createSupabaseDataSource with Supabase Realtime. Change a task on one side and the other shows it. A new record gets its uuid from the database, and a window taken offline shows a failed save putting the cell back.

faq.question: Does this need a Supabase account?
faq.answer: Not for the demo: the project is simulated in the page, so it runs anywhere. In an app, pass a real client from createClient(url, anonKey) to createSupabaseDataSource and createSupabaseRealtime; nothing else changes.

faq.question: How do changes from other users arrive?
faq.answer: The realtime option of baseSource subscribes to the table with createSupabaseRealtime. When a change arrives, the base reads the table again and takes what moved, without writing anything back. Turn on Realtime for the table in Supabase for it to send changes.

faq.question: What about row level security?
faq.answer: The base talks to Supabase with the signed in user's client, so your policies decide what each person reads and writes. A write a policy refuses comes back as an error, and the base puts the cell back and shows the message.

faq.question: Which license does it need?
faq.answer: SvGrid Base and the Supabase source are part of the Suite edition of @svgrid/enterprise. Without a key they run with a watermark, so they can be evaluated as is.
